ai_summary: This disclosure reports a planned inter-family transfer of 30.92% of DCM Shriram International Ltd. shares to Alok Bansidhar Shriram, an existing promoter, effective July 2026, structured as a gift with a NIL acquisition price. While significantly increasing Alok Bansidhar Shriram's individual ownership, this transaction is an internal re-arrangement within the promoter group, resulting in no change to the aggregate promoter shareholding (50.11%) and is exempt from an open offer. No red flags are present as the NIL price and lack of open offer are justified by the inter-family gift exemption under SEBI regulations.
